# Row kinds. REPO: donor repository -> its GitHub URL (PROVENANCE.tsv builds blob URLs from it). FILE: donor path (donor repository root) -> target path (module root m3/algorithms). PACKAGE: donor package -> target package. TYPE: donor top-level type -> target type (nested types Node, Interval, Shape, Family, None keep their names). EXTERNAL: third-party package the donor imports, kept (the pom carries the dependency). DROP_METHOD: <DonorType>.<method> whose whole declaration (annotations to closing brace, one trailing blank line) the recipe removes -> owner or reason. DROP_LINE: <DonorType> -> regex of the single source lines the recipe removes. DROP_DUMP: <TargetType> -> regex of the donor differential-dump lines that belong to a dropped row (differential.sh deletes them on the donor side only). SKIP: donor files of the module this leaf does not relocate -> reason. NEC: an overlap the recipe does not decide (names and both blob shas) -> a human decides equivalence. SUPERSEDED: a FILE row a later recipe took over (named in the note): relocate.py no longer writes the target, differential.sh still compiles the donor source on the donor side.
